{{Quote|I am your humble servant.|translated=1|Maseloo greets a customer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Maseloo''', known as '''Honest Maseloo''' to his customers, was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked as a weapon modifications [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, he operated a stall in the [[Alien Enclave Market]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Voss-Ka]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Maseloo wore [[Color/Legends|brown]] and gray [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] while at his stall and spoke a language other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|basic]] to customers. He had green skin, no hair and purple [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maseloo first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he serves as a Republic and Imperial weapon mods vendor on the planet Voss. His location is also marked on a map in [[Prima Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.
